items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: And Gordon told me, he says, I caught him with his head and I dress up.

ctx.x: Yeah, the band room, yeah. And Sandy used to bring his gals up in there. And he was over there. And Gordon told me, he says, I caught him with his head and I dress up. And he says, I can't say anything more than that. But he says, I caught him. And Sandy says, what were you doing? He said, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha.
You know how Sandy laughed at all? That's when Sandy was giving him. I'm telling you, he was something. You mean the United States or Mexico?
